title: Zesty Saudi Arabian Lamb Kebabs
description: A briny and crunchy Saudi Arabian dish featuring lamb, this recipe is a hangover cure and can be made vegetarian friendly by substituting the lamb with portobello mushrooms, grilled to perfection on a binchotan grill and shaped like nigiri for a unique twist
instructions: Preheat the binchotan grill to medium high heat
In a large bowl, whisk together lemon juice, olive oil, garlic, ginger, paprika, cumin, salt, black pepper, and sumac
Add the lamb cubes to the bowl and toss to coat with the marinade
Thread the marinated lamb cubes onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece
Grill the lamb kebabs for 8-10 minutes per side, or until they reach an internal temperature of 145 degrees
Let the kebabs rest for 5 minutes before serving
Shape the lamb kebabs into nigiri shapes, if desired
Serve the lamb kebabs hot, garnished with additional sumac and parsley if desired
